name: Shemesh 2019 atezolizumab pediatric PopPK scenarios
description: Source fixed-effect projections, with explicit dose cap and exposure endpoints. No cohort-reproduction claim.

scenarios.name: Infant median covariates
scenarios.description: Fixed-effect projection using published coefficients. Covariate combinations are diagnostic subjects, not reconstructed patients or cohort medians. Dose amounts are fixed in this scenario: recompute the regimen when editing weight. Pediatric dose=min(15 mg/kg,1200 mg); age>=18 dose=1200 mg. No age effect in the final PK equations.
